Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِيْ وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْء
Translation: O Allah, I beseech You by Your mercy which encompasses all things

Arabic text: وَبِقُوَّتِكَ الَّتِيْ قَهَرْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيْء
Translation: And by Your power by which You subdued all things
And to which all things submitted
And to which all things yielded

Arabic text: وَبِجَبَرُوتِكَ الَّتِيْ غَلَبْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيْء
Translation: And by Your might by which You overcame all things
And by Your glory which nothing can withstand
And by Your greatness which has filled all things
And by Your authority which towers over all things

Arabic text: وَبِوَجْهِكَ الْبَاقِيْ بَعْدَ فَنَاءِ كُلِّ شَيْء
Translation: And by Your face which will remain after the annihilation of all things

Arabic text: وَبِأَسْمَائِكَ الَّتِيْ مَلَأَتْ أَرْكَانَ كُلِّ شَيْء
Translation: And by Your names which have filled the pillars of all things
And by Your knowledge which encompasses all things

Arabic text: وَبِنُوْرِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذِيْ أَضَاءَ لَهُ كُلُّ شَيْء
Translation: And by the light of Your face which illuminates all things
O Light, O Holy One
O First of the first ones
And O Last of the last ones

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ تَهْتِكُ الْعِصَمَ
Translation: O Allah, forgive me the sins that tear apart protection

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ تُنْزِلُ النِّقَمَ
Translation: O Allah, forgive me the sins that bring down punishment

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ تُغَيِّرُ النِّعَمَ
Translation: O Allah, forgive me the sins that alter blessings

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ تَحْبِسُ الدُّعَاءَ
Translation: O Allah, forgive me the sins that withhold supplications

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ تَقْطَعُ الرَّجَاءَ
Translation: O Allah, forgive me the sins that cut off hope

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ تُنْزِلُ الْبَلَاءَ
Translation: O Allah, forgive me the sins that bring down calamities

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ أَذْنَبْتُهُ، وَكُلَّ خَطِيئَةٍ أَخْطَأْتُهَا
Translation: O Allah, forgive me every sin I have committed and every mistake I have made
O Allah, I seek nearness to You through Your remembrance
And I seek Your intercession with Yourself

Arabic text: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِجُودِكَ أَنْ تُدْنِيَنِيْ مِنْ قُرْبِكَ
Translation: And I ask You by Your generosity to bring me closer to You
And to grant me the ability to thank You
And to inspire me to remember You

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ سُؤَالَ خَاضِعٍ مُتَذَلِّلٍ خَاشِعٍ، أَنْ تُسَامِحَنِيْ وَتَرْحَمَنِي
Translation: O Allah, I ask You with the asking of one who is submissive, humble, and reverent, that You forgive me and have mercy on me

Arabic text: وَتَجْعَلَنِيْ بِقِسْمِكَ رَاضِيًا قَانِعًا، وَفِيْ جَمِيْعِ الْأَحْوَالِ مُتَوَاضِعًا
Translation: And make me content and satisfied with what You have apportioned, and in all circumstances, humble

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَأَسْأَلُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You with the asking of one whose poverty is severe
And who has brought his need to You in times of hardship
And whose desire for what You have is great
O Allah, Your authority is great, and Your station is exalted
Your plan is hidden, and Your command is manifest
Your might is overwhelming, and Your power is in effect
And it is not possible to escape from Your judgment
O Allah, I find no forgiver for my sins
And no concealer for my ugly deeds

Arabic text: وَلَا لِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عَمَلِيَ الْقَبِيحِ بِالْحَسَنِ مُبَدِّلًا غَيْرَكَ
Translation: And no transformer of any of my evil deeds into good ones except You
There is no god but You
Glory be to You, and praise
I have wronged myself
And I have been emboldened in my ignorance

Arabic text: وَسَكَنْتُ إِلٰى قَدِيمِ ذِكْرِكَ لِيْ وَمَنِّكَ عَلَيَّ
Translation: And I have relied upon Your ancient remembrance of me and Your favor upon me
O Allah, my Master
How many ugly deeds You have concealed

Arabic text: وَكَمْ مِنْ فَادِحٍ مِنَ الْبَلَاءِ أَقَلْتَهُ
Translation: And how many burdensome afflictions You have alleviated
And how many stumbles You have prevented
And how many troubles You have removed

Arabic text: وَكَمْ مِنْ ثَنَاءٍ جَمِيلٍ لَسْتُ أَهْلًا لَهُ نَشَرْتَهُ
Translation: And how much beautiful praise, which I did not deserve, You have spread
O Allah, my affliction is great
And my bad state has exceeded bounds
And my deeds fall short
And my fetters have held me back
And the remoteness of my hopes has confined me from benefiting myself

Arabic text: وَخَدَعَتْنِيْ الدُّنْيَا بِغُرُورِهَا، وَنَفْسِيْ بِجِنَايَتِهَا وَمِطَالِيْ
Translation: And the world has deceived me with its delusions, and my soul with its offenses and procrastinations

Arabic text: يَا سَيِّدِيْ فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِعِزَّتِكَ أَنْ لَايَحْجُبَ عَنْكَ دُعَائِي سُوءُ عَمَلِيْ وَفِعَالِيْ
Translation: O my Master, so I ask You by Your glory not to let my evil deeds and actions veil my supplication from You

Arabic text: وَلَا تَفْضَحْنِيْ بِخَفِيِّ مَا اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سِرِّيْ
Translation: And do not expose me by the hidden things of which You have knowledge from my secrets

Arabic text: وَلَا تُعَاجِلْنِيْ بِالْعُقُوبَةِ عَلَى مَا عَمِلْتُهُ فِيْ خَلَوَاتِيْ
Translation: And do not hasten me to punishment for what I have done in private
Of my evil deeds and wrongdoings
And my continuous negligence and ignorance
And my excessive desires and heedlessness

Arabic text: وَكُنِ اللَّهُمَّ بِعِزَّتِكَ لِيْ فِيْ كُلِّ الْأَحْوَالِ رَؤُوفًا
Translation: And be, O Allah, by Your glory, compassionate to me in all circumstances
And gracious to me in all affairs

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ وَرَبِّي مَنْ لِيْ غَيْرُكَ، أَسْأَلُهُ كَشْفَ ضُرِّى، وَالنَّظَرَ فِيْ أَمْرِيْ
Translation: My God and my Lord, who do I have besides You whom I can ask to remove my affliction and look into my affairs?

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ وَمَوْلَايَ أَجْرَيْتَ عَلَيَّ حُكْمًا اِتَّبَعْتُ فِيهِ هَوٰى نَفْسِي
Translation: My God and my Master, You have applied a law to me which I followed due to my base desires

Arabic text: وَلَمْ أَحْتَرِسْ فِيهِ مِنْ تَزْيِينِ عَدُوِّيْ
Translation: And I did not protect myself from the embellishment of my enemy

Arabic text: فَغَرَّنِيْ بِمَا أَهْوٰى وَأَسْعَدَهُ عَلٰى ذٰلِكَ الْقَضَاءُ
Translation: So he deceived me with what I desired, and fate aided him in that

Arabic text: فَتَجَاوَزْتُ بِمَا جَرٰى عَلَيَّ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ بَعْضَ حُدُودِكَ
Translation: Thus I transgressed some of Your limits because of what happened to me
And I opposed some of Your commands

Arabic text: فَلَكَ الحُجَّةُ عَلَيَّ فِيْ جَمِيْعِ ذٰلِكَ
Translation: So Yours is the argument against me in all of that

Arabic text: وَلَا حُجَّةَ لِيْ فِيمَا جَرٰى عَلَيَّ فِيهِ قَضَاؤُكَ
Translation: And I have no argument concerning what Your decree has executed upon me
And Your judgment and affliction have obligated me

Arabic text: وَقَدْ أَتَيْتُكَ يَا إِلٰهِيْ بَعْدَ تَقْصِيرِيْ وَ إِسْرَافِيْ عَلَى نَفْسِي
Translation: And I have come to You, my God, after having fallen short and been excessive against myself
Apologetic, regretful
Broken, seeking forgiveness
Repentant, returning
Acknowledging, confessing, admitting
I find no escape from what I have done

Arabic text: وَلَا مَفْزَعًا أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْهِ فِيْ أَمْرِيْ
Translation: And no place of refuge to which to turn in my affairs

Arabic text: غَيْرَ قَبُوْ لِكَ عُذْرِيْ وَ إِدْخَالِكَ إِيَّايَ فِيْ سَعَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: Other than Your acceptance of my excuse and Your entering me into the vastness of Your mercy
O Allah, so accept my excuse
And have mercy on the severity of my affliction
And release me from the tightness of my fetters

Arabic text: يَا رَبِّ ارْحَمْ ضَعْفَ بَدَنِيْ، وَرِقَّةَ جِلْدِيْ، وَدِقَّةَ عَظْمِيْ
Translation: O my Lord, have mercy on the weakness of my body, and the thinness of my skin, and the delicateness of my bones

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ بَدَأَ خَلْقِيْ وَذِكْرِيْ وَتَرْبِيَتِيْ وَبِرِّى وَتَغْذِيَتِيْ
Translation: O You who began my creation, my remembrance, my upbringing, my goodness, and my nourishment

Arabic text: هَبْنِيْ لِابْتِدَاءِ كَرَمِكَ وَسَالِفِ بِرِّكَ بِيْ
Translation: Grant me a gift for the beginning of Your generosity and Your previous goodness to me
O my God, my Master, and my Lord
Do You see Yourself punishing me with Your fire after my belief in Your oneness?

Arabic text: وَبَعْدَ مَا انْطَوٰى عَلَيْهِ قَلْبِىْ مِنْ مَعْرِفَتِكَ
Translation: And after my heart has contained knowledge of You?
And after my tongue has continuously mentioned Your remembrance?
And after my conscience has acknowledged Your love?

Arabic text: وَبَعْدَ صِدْقِ اعْتِرَافِيْ وَدُعَائِي خَاضِعًا لِرُبُوبِيَّتِكَ
Translation: And after the sincerity of my confession and my supplication, humbly made to Your lordship?

Arabic text: هَيْهَاتَ أَنْتَ أَكْرَمُ مِنْ أَنْ تُضَيِّعَ مَنْ رَبَّيْتَهُ
Translation: Far be it from You! You are more generous than to waste one whom You have raised
Or to drive away one whom You have brought near
Or to banish one whom You have sheltered

Arabic text: أَوْ تُسَلِّمَ إِلَى الْبَلَاءِ مَنْ كَفَيْتَهُ وَرَحِمْتَهُ
Translation: Or to deliver to affliction one whom You have spared and shown mercy

Arabic text: وَلَيْتَ شِعْرِيْ يَا سَيِّدِيْ وَ إِلٰهِيْ وَمَوْلَايَ
Translation: Would that I knew, O my Master, my God, my Protector, and my Lord

Arabic text: أَتُسَلِّطُ النَّارَ عَلٰى وُجُوهٍ خَرَّتْ لِعَظَمَتِكَ سَاجِدَةً
Translation: Would You impose fire upon faces that have fallen prostrate before Your greatness?

Arabic text: وَعَلٰى أَلْسُنٍ نَطَقَتْ بِتَوْحِيدِكَ صَادِقَةً، وَبِشُكْرِكَ مَادِحَةً
Translation: And upon tongues that have spoken sincerely of Your oneness, and have thanked You with praise?
And upon hearts that have acknowledged Your divinity with conviction?

Arabic text: وَعَلٰى ضَمَائِرَ حَوَتْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ بِكَ حَتَّىٰ صَارَتْ خَاشِعَةً
Translation: And upon minds that have gained such knowledge of You that they have become humble?

Arabic text: وَعَلٰى جَوَارِحَ سَعَتْ إِلٰى أَوْطَانِ تَعَبُّدِكَ طَائِعَةً، وَ أَشَارَتْ بِاسْتِغْفَارِكَ مُذْعِنَةً
Translation: And upon limbs that have hurried to the places of Your worship in obedience, and have gestured with seeking Your forgiveness in submission?

Arabic text: مَا هٰكَذَا الظَّنُّ بِكَ، وَلَا أُخْبِرْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ عَنْكَ يَا كَرِيْمُ
Translation: Such is not the thought of You, nor have we been informed of Your grace, O Generous One!

Arabic text: يَا رَبِّ وَأَنْتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفِيْ عَنْ قَلِيلٍ مِنْ بَلاءِ الدُّنْيَا وَعُقُوبَاتِهَا
Translation: O Lord, You know my weakness before a little of this world's tribulations and punishments

Arabic text: وَمَا يَجْرِيْ فِيهَا مِنَ الْمَكَارِهِ عَلٰى أَهْلِهَا
Translation: And what flows in it of afflictions upon its inhabitants

Arabic text: عَلَى أَنَّ ذٰلِكَ بَلَاءٌ وَمَكْرُوْهٌ قَلِيْلٌ مَكْثُهُ، يَسِيْرٌ بَقَاؤُهُ، قَصِيْرٌ مُدَّتُهُ
Translation: Even though it is a tribulation and affliction whose stay is short, whose duration is brief, whose period is fleeting

Arabic text: فَكَيْفَ احْتِمَالِيْ لِبَلاءِ الْآخِرَةِ وَجَلِيلِ وُقُوعِ الْمَكَارِهِ فِيْهَا
Translation: So how can I endure the tribulations of the Hereafter and the great afflictions that occur within it?

Arabic text: وَهُوَ بَلاءٌ تَطُولُ مُدَّتُهُ، وَيَدُومُ مَقَامُهُ، وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْ أَهْلِهِ
Translation: For it is a tribulation whose period is long, whose station endures, and whose sufferers are not relieved

Arabic text: لِأَنَّهُ لَايَكُوْنُ إِلَّا عَنْ غَضَبِكَ وَانْتِقَامِكَ وَسَخَطِكَ
Translation: Because it only occurs as a result of Your anger, vengeance, and wrath

Arabic text: وَهٰذَا مَا لَاتَقُومُ لَهُ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ
Translation: And these are what the heavens and earth cannot withstand
O my Master, so how about me?

Arabic text: وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ الضَّعِيفُ الذَّلِيلُ الْحَقِيرُ الْمِسْكِينُ الْمُسْتَكِيْنُ
Translation: For I am Your weak, lowly, base, wretched, and miserable servant
O my God, my Lord, my Master, and my Protector
For which things would I complain to You?
And for which of them would I lament and weep?
For the severe punishment and its intensity?
Or for the length of tribulation and its duration?
So if You subject me to the punishments with Your enemies
And gather me with the people of Your tribulation
And separate me from Your beloved ones and Your saints

Arabic text: فَهَبْنِيْ يَا إِلٰهِيْ وَسَيِّدِيْ وَمَوْلَايَ وَرَبِّي، صَبَرْتُ عَلٰى عَذَابِكَ
Translation: Then suppose, my God, my Master, my Protector, and my Lord, that I am patient with Your punishment
How can I be patient with separation from You?
And suppose that I am patient with the heat of Your fire

Arabic text: فَكَيْفَ أَصْبِرُ عَنِ النَّظَرِ إِلٰى كَرَامَتِكَ
Translation: How can I be patient with not gazing upon Your generosity?

Arabic text: أَمْ كَيْفَ أَسْكُنُ فِيْ النَّارِ وَرَجَائِي عَفْوُكَ
Translation: Or how can I dwell in the Fire while my hope is Your pardon?

Arabic text: فَبِعِزَّتِكَ يَا سَيِّدِيْ وَمَوْلَايَ أُقْسِمُ صَادِقًا، لَئِنْ تَرَكْتَنِيْ نَاطِقًا
Translation: So by Your might, O my Master and my Protector, I swear sincerely, if You leave me with speech

Arabic text: لَأَضِجَّنَّ إِلَيْكَ بَيْنَ أَهْلِهَا ضَجِيجَ الْآمِلِيْنَ
Translation: I will lament to You from amidst its inhabitants with the lamentation of the hopeful
And I will cry to You with the cry of those crying for help
And I will weep to You with the weeping of the bereft

Arabic text: وَلَأُنَادِيَنَّكَ أَيْنَ كُنْتَ يَا وَلِيَّ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
Translation: And I will call to You: Where are You, O Guardian of the believers?
O Goal of the hopes of the knowers!
O Helper of those who seek help!
O Beloved of the hearts of the truthful!
And O God of the worlds!

Arabic text: أَفَتُرَاكَ سُبْحَانَكَ يَا إِلٰهِيْ وَبِحَمْدِكَ تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا صَوْتَ عَبْدٍ مُسْلِمٍ
Translation: Can You see Yourself—Glory be to You, my God, and Yours is the praise—hearing therein the voice of a Muslim servant
Who was imprisoned there because of his disobedience
And tasted the flavor of its punishment because of his sins
And is confined between its layers because of his crime and violation

Arabic text: وَهُوَ يَضِجُّ إِلَيْكَ ضَجِيجَ مُؤَمِّلٍ لِرَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: And he cries to You with the cry of one hopeful for Your mercy
And calls to You with the tongue of those who profess Your oneness
And entreats You by Your lordship

Arabic text: يَا مَوْلاَيَ فَكَيْفَ يَبْقٰى فِيْ الْعَذَابِ وَهُوَ يَرْجُوْ مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ حِلْمِكَ
Translation: O my Protector, how could he remain in punishment while he hopes for Your past clemency?

Arabic text: أَمْ كَيْفَ تُؤْلِمُهُ النَّارُ وَهُوَ يَأْمُلُ فَضْلَكَ وَرَحْمَتَكَ
Translation: Or how could the Fire cause him pain while he expects Your bounty and mercy?

Arabic text: أَمْ كَيْفَ يُحْرِقُهُ لَهِيبُهَا وَأَنْتَ تَسْمَعُ صَوْتَهُ وَتَرىٰ مَكَانَهُ
Translation: Or how could its flames burn him while You hear his voice and see his place?

Arabic text: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَشْتَمِلُ عَلَيْهِ زَفِيرُهَا وَأَنْتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفَهُ
Translation: Or how could its groaning enshroud him while You know his weakness?

Arabic text: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَتَقَلْقَلُ بَيْنَ أَطْبَاقِهَا وَأَنْتَ تَعْلَمُ صِدْقَهُ
Translation: Or how could he be convulsed among its layers while You know his sincerity?

Arabic text: أَمْ كَيْفَ تَزْجُرُهُ زَبَانِيَتُهَا وَهُوَ يُنَادِيْكَ يَا رَبَّهُ
Translation: Or how could its keepers torture him while he calls out to You, "O Lord"?

Arabic text: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَرْجُوْ فَضْلَكَ فِيْ عِتْقِهِ مِنْهَا فَتَتْرُكُهُ فِيْهَا
Translation: Or how could he hope for Your grace in freeing him from it, yet You abandon him therein?
Far be it from You! That is not what is expected of You
Nor what is known of Your bounty

Arabic text: وَلَا مُشْبِهٌ لِمَا عَامَلْتَ بِهِ الْمُوَحِّدِيْنَ مِنْ بِرِّكَ وَ إِحْسَانِكَ
Translation: Nor is it similar to the goodness and kindness You have shown to those who believe in Your oneness

Arabic text: فَبِالْيَقِينِ أَقْطَعُ، لَوْلَا مَا حَكَمْتَ بِهِ مِنْ تَعْذِيبِ جَاحِدِيْكَ
Translation: So with certainty I declare that were it not for what You have decreed concerning the punishment of Your deniers
And what You have foreordained concerning the everlasting abode of those who stubbornly resist You
You would have made the Fire all of it cool and safe

Arabic text: وَمَا كَانَ لِأَحَدٍ فِيهَا مَقَرًّا وَلَا مُقَامًا
Translation: And no one would have had a place of rest or abode in it

Arabic text: لَكِنَّكَ تَقَدَّسَتْ أَسْمَاؤُكَ أَقْسَمْتَ أَنْ تَمْلَأَهَا مِنَ الْكَافِرِيْنَ
Translation: But You, holy are Your names, have sworn that You will fill it with the unbelievers
From among the jinn and mankind together
And that You will place those who stubbornly resist therein forever

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ قُلْتَ مُبْتَدِئًا، وَتَطَوَّلْتَ بِالْإِنْعَامِ مُتَكَرِّمًا
Translation: And You, majestic is Your praise, said at the beginning and were gracious through kindness as a favor

Arabic text: أَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًا لَا يَسْتَوُوْنَ
Translation: "Is one who is a believer like one who is corrupt? They are not equal."

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ وَسَيِّدِيْ، فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِيْ قَدَّرْتَهَا
Translation: My God and my Master, so I ask You by the power which You have decreed

Arabic text: وَبِالْقَضِيَّةِ الَّتِيْ حَتَمْتَهَا وَحَكَمْتَهَا، وَغَلَبْتَ مَنْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرَيْتَهَا
Translation: And by the decision which You have determined and imposed, and prevailed over whom You have applied it to

Arabic text: أَنْ تَهَبَ لِيْ فِيْ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَفِيْ هَذِهِ السَّاعَةِ
Translation: That You forgive me in this night and at this hour
Every crime I have committed
And every sin I have performed
And every ugly thing I have concealed
And every folly I have enacted
Whether I have hidden it or made it public
Whether I have concealed it or manifested it

Arabic text: وَكُلَّ سَيِّئَةٍ أَمَرْتَ بِإِثْبَاتِهَا الْكِرَامَ الْكَاتِبِيْنَ
Translation: And every evil deed You have ordered the noble scribes to record

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْنَ وَكَّلْتَهُمْ بِحِفْظِ مَا يَكُونُ مِنِّيْ
Translation: Who You have appointed to observe what comes from me
And whom You have made, along with my limbs, witnesses against me

Arabic text: وَكُنْتَ أَنْتَ الرَّقِيبَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ
Translation: And You were Yourself the Watcher over me from behind them
And the Witness of what is hidden from them
But through Your mercy You concealed it
And through Your grace You veiled it

Arabic text: وَأَنْ تُوَفِّرَ حَظِّى مِنْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ أَنْزَلْتَهُ
Translation: And that You bestow upon me an abundant share of any good that You send down
Or kindness that You confer
Or goodness that You unfold
Or provision that You spread out
Or sin that You forgive
Or error that You cover

Arabic text: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
Translation: O Lord! O Lord! O Lord!

Arabic text: يَا إِلٰهِيْ وَسَيِّدِيْ وَمَوْلَايَ وَمَالِكَ رِقِّيْ
Translation: O my God, my Master, my Protector, and Owner of my bondage
O He in whose hand is my forelock
O He who knows my affliction and my misery
O He who is aware of my poverty and my destitution

Arabic text: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
Translation: O Lord! O Lord! O Lord!
I ask You by Your truth and Your holiness
And the greatest of Your attributes and names

Arabic text: أَنْ تَجْعَلَ أَوْقَاتِيْ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ بِذِكْرِكَ مَعْمُورَةً
Translation: That You make my times in the night and the day inhabited by Your remembrance
And joined to Your service
And my deeds acceptable to You

Arabic text: حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ أَعْمَالِيْ وَأَوْرَادِيْ كُلُّهَا وِرْدًا وَاحِدًا
Translation: So that my deeds and my litanies may all be a single litany
And my occupation in Your service everlasting

Arabic text: يَا سَيِّدِيْ يَا مَنْ عَلَيْهِ مُعَوَّلِيْ
Translation: O my Master! O He upon whom I rely
O He to whom I complain about my conditions

Arabic text: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
Translation: O Lord! O Lord! O Lord!
Strengthen my limbs for Your service
And fortify my resolve in determination
And grant me earnestness in my fear of You
And continuity in my being joined to Your service

Arabic text: حَتّىٰ أَسْرَحَ إِلَيْكَ فِيْ مَيَادِينِ السَّابِقِينَ
Translation: So that I may move toward You in the fields of the foremost
And hurry to You among those who hasten
And yearn for Your nearness among the yearning
And draw near to You with the nearness of the sincere
And fear You with the fear of those who have certainty
And gather in Your vicinity with the believers
O Allah, whoever wishes me evil, wish him the same
And whoever plots against me, plot against him

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْنِيْ مِنْ أَحْسَنِ عَبِيدِكَ نَصِيبًا عِنْدَكَ
Translation: And make me among the best of Your servants in share with You
And the nearest of them in station to You
And the most privileged of them in proximity to You
For that cannot be attained except by Your grace
So grant me generously by Your generosity
And be compassionate to me by Your glory
And protect me by Your mercy
And make my tongue dedicated to Your remembrance
And my heart enthralled with Your love
And grant me the favor of Your good response
And overlook my stumbling
And forgive my slip
For You have decreed upon Your servants Your worship
And You have commanded them to supplicate to You
And You have assured them of a response
So to You, O Lord, I have turned my face
And to You, O Lord, I have extended my hand
So by Your might, answer my prayer
And allow me to attain my desires
And do not cut off my hope from Your favor

Arabic text: وَاكْفِنِيْ شَرَّ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ مِنْ أَعْدَائِيْ
Translation: And spare me the evil of the jinn and mankind from among my enemies
O Quick to be pleased
Forgive the one who owns nothing but supplication
For You do whatever You will
O He whose name is a remedy
And whose remembrance is a healing
And whose obedience is wealth
Have mercy on one whose capital is hope
And whose weapon is weeping
O Perfector of blessings
O Repeller of adversities
O Light of those who are lonely in darkness
O Knower who was never taught

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And do with me what is worthy of You

Arabic text: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُوْ لِهِ وَالْأَئِمَّةِ الْمَيَامِيْنَ مِنْ آلِهِ
Translation: And may Allah bless His Messenger and the blessed Imams of his family
And give them abundant peace
